shuffled_spec.description: Diagnosis: Premature convergence with persistent stagnation (stag_max up to 160) and low success fraction (mean ~0.2-0.45) despite high initial diversity. Evidence: improvement_rate is near zero across all runs, diversity declines steadily (e.g., 55.57 to 22.42), and stagnation_steps exceed 5 frequently. Failure mode: rand/1/bin with F=0.5 lacks sufficient exploration pressure; once diversity drops, the population cannot escape local optima. Falsifiable prediction: Switching to rand/2/bin when stagnation_steps >= 5 will increase success_fraction and reduce stagnation_steps in subsequent generations compared to the baseline rand/1/bin policy.
